payload.title: P4-13: secret-safe on-demand revalidation for Pretext sites
payload.description: Pretext pages use revalidate = 3600. Immediate refresh on publish needs a shared secret between the backend (content-actions calls /api/revalidate) and the Next app, and the template has no secret-safe way to set it: a public site.json cannot hold it, and console-set branch variables are wiped by the next stack update (TI today keeps PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET as a plain branch env var). Design and implement a secret-safe path (e.g. Amplify backend secret read at runtime by both sides, or another mechanism that survives stack updates and never lands in site.json or Git), update app/api/revalidate/route.ts, the content-actions trigger, the template and docs, with tests. Rotate the existing TI secret at cutover; the new backend must not reuse it. Sequence after P5-01 (PPY-f1f695), which also touches app/api/revalidate/route.ts.
